plain_english_policy: This bill clarifies that local school boards must notify teachers in writing about a reduction in pay caused specifically by losing a supplemental position (like coaching) before the end of the current school term. Under this new rule, if a teacher does not object to such a notice within 15 days after it is given, they are considered to have accepted their reemployment for the next year at the reduced salary.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would establish a procedural requirement ensuring transparency regarding pay cuts linked to lost supplemental roles. It prevents schools from silently reducing compensation and gives teachers a specific window (until June 15th) to contest non-reemployment or accept new terms, thereby formalizing the process for handling reductions in total teacher salary due to budget constraints on extra duties.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors support clarifying existing reemployment laws to include compensation reductions from lost supplemental positions within the standard notice period.
evidence_quotes: "This bill would clarify that the notice requirement also applies to a reduction in compensation pursuant to the loss of a supplemental position."

"To amend Section 16-24-12... to clarify the requirement that a local board of education notify a teacher of a reduction in compensation pursuant to the loss of a supplemental position on or before the last day of the preceding school term."
